subject: Short evaluation - extension request and structured concession
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@clearmap.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Hi Karthik,

Hope you had a good weekend. We hit a roadblock integrating the evaluation build with our data ingestion pipeline and need a little more runway to validate end-to-end LLM behavior against our anonymized telemetry. Would Redwood consider a short extension of the 30-day pilot (2 weeks) and either a modest discount on the follow-on month or a small pool of credits to help cover additional inference spikes while we finish integration?

A few context points:
- We're doing a SOC 2 readiness sprint the week of May 17 and want to include Redwood in a quick internal demo.
- If the extended pilot shows stable latency and cost we're likely to move to a paid POC or a 3-month pilot with a throughput commitment.

Can you let me know what flexibility you have here? Preferably something quick we can sign (email confirmation is fine).

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Platforms
ClearMap.ai

Attachments: none
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@clearmap.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Sara — thanks for the note and the clear context. We can definitely find a path here. Looping in Priyom (commercial) and Laura (sales ops) to put options on paper.

Quick Q: would you prefer a straight 14-day extension with no charge, or a shorter (14-day) extension plus a convert-to-commit discount if you upgrade to a 3-month/6-month package? That second option helps us keep predictable economics and usually maps to tighter unit pricing for teams.

I’ll follow up with two concrete options tomorrow.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Internal only: Sara asked for a 2-week runway to finish integration. They flagged SOC2 readiness week (May 17) and want a quick confirmation they can share in the demo. Options I'm thinking: 

Option A (low friction): 14-day extension at no charge, no other commercial commitments. Clean, fast, minimal precedent risk.

Option B (conversion incentive): 14-day extension + 25% off the first paid month if they sign a 3-month commit within 30 days of pilot end. Alternatively offer a credit bucket (4k inference credits) in lieu of discount.

Operational asks: if we do Option B we should attach a very small amendment (email-signable) and route to Legal for a 1-paragraph addendum. Laura — can you draft the amendment + pricing table? Priyom — what's our comfort on the 25% level vs credits? I want to avoid setting a discount anchor we'll have to replicate too often.

Also thinking about adding an SLA warranty for the demo: 99th pctl latency guarantee for the demo timeframe or a small trial SLA credit clause. That might reassure their infra folks.

Thoughts?
—Karthik
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Karthik — I prefer Option B but tweak to reduce discount: 30% feels high for a short-term conversion incentive; propose 20% off the first paid month, or 4,000 credits valued at net-equivalent. Credits buy us flexibility (they can't resell, but they do lower revenue recognition pressure).

If they agree to convert to a 6-month commit we can tier further (additional volume discount at month 3). For the SLA ask: include a one-time demo warranty (latency target + 4 hours of on-call senior infra during the demo window) rather than a long-term SLA promise.

Laura — if you can draft the amendment + one-page pricing comparison (credits vs discount) I’ll sign off.

—Priyom
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@clearmap.ai>, Paul Miller <pmiller@clearmap.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Sara / Paul — thanks again for the clear ask and timeline. We discussed internally and can offer the following, scoped to keep approvals light and avoid long legal cycles: 

Our counteroffer (two quick paths):

1) Extension + credits (recommended)
- 14-day pilot extension (no extra usage charges during the extension)
- 4,000 inference credits applied immediately to your account (usable for any Redwood-hosted inference)
- One-time 8 hours of professional services to assist with the integration + a priority demo slot during SOC2 week

2) Extension + convert incentive
- 14-day pilot extension
- 20% discount on the first paid month if you convert to a 3-month paid pilot within 30 days after the extended period
- Demo warranty: a one-week elevated observability support window and a demo-specific latency target (our senior infra will be on-call for the demo)

Operational notes: we’ve prepared a short amendment that can be signed by email (attached) and a pricing comparison table to show credits vs discount (attached). If you'd prefer DocuSign we can route that as well.

Please reply with the option you prefer and any small edits you want on the amendment; we can turn on the extension as soon as we get confirmation.

Attachments: clearmap-pilot-amendment-v1.pdf (amendment stub), pricing-comparison-credits-vs-discount.xlsx (pricing table)

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@clearmap.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Paul Miller <pmiller@clearmap.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot - can we extend + pricing help?

Thanks — option 1 (credits + 14-day extension + 8hr PS) works best for us. We appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of small asks:

- Can the amendment include a one-sentence demo SLA credit (3% credit if demo latency exceeds the demo target)? We only need it for the SOC2 demo artifacts.
- We prefer DocuSign for signature.

If you can route the DocuSign link I’ll get this approved internally and sign today. Once signed, can you confirm when the extension will be enabled and when the credits appear in our console?

Acceptance: Option 1 accepted pending the one-sentence SLA tweak.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Platforms
ClearMap.ai
